# Agenda 0.10.5
- The board refreshes with about half as much data. Todo notes now load once in the background and then only when they change, instead of being re-sent on every update. Search still covers notes; for the first second or so after Agenda opens, it matches todo titles only until notes have loaded. - Agents and scripts can request the lighter board with `GET /api/projects?todo_notes=summary` and fetch note text with `GET /api/todo-notes`. The default `/api/projects` response is unchanged.

# Agenda 0.10.4
- Fixes a memory leak that made Agenda slow down the longer it stayed open. Every time the board updated, it kept a hidden copy of the previous board in memory, so after a few days the app could use several gigabytes. On a busy Mac that showed up as lag, or as a blank window for a moment when switching back to Agenda. Memory now stays flat however long Agenda runs.

# Agenda 0.10.3
- Pinch the trackpad to zoom the whole board out, so more of it fits on screen. It zooms in steps from today's size down to 40%, and everything shrinks together like an optical zoom. ⌘− and ⌘= also zoom, and ⌘0 or the small percentage badge in the corner resets to 100%. Each Mac remembers its zoom. - Fixes a Pulse note (such as an overdue deadline) drawing on top of a todo's deadline clock.
